notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content: [p][b]Content Update[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Added new boss: [b]Moose God[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added new elite monster: [b]Feathered Serpent[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added card [b]"Link Break"[/b] — Use this card to break links! All starter decks now include one copy. Additional copies can be obtained during your journey (if needed).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the [b]\[Charge][/b] mechanic: Units will now reverse direction after reaching the end of the board (preventing deadlocks when both Lords have \[Charge]).[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Balance Updates[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Ape God[/b] now generates only 1 Banana per turn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Black Turtle[/b] cost increased by 1.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Swordmaster[/b] stats after upgrade adjusted to [b]4/7[/b] (increased).[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bunch of bugs.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Optimizations & Visual Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Polished various details and visuals.[/p][/*][/list]
